ledger.claim: TriggerPoint GRID Foam Roller for Exercise
ledger.explanation: The most recent past orders are for fitness and exercise gear: "Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 40 Running Shoes" (Jan 12, 2026) and "Manduka PRO Yoga Mat, 6mm Thick" with "TriggerPoint GRID Foam Roller for Exercise" (Dec 28, 2025).
Order AMZ100247 for running shoes and socks shows "$121.23". Order AMZ100245 for the yoga mat and foam roller shows "$129.89". Together they come to $251.12.

ledger.claim: Blues at Sharks, Oct 9 · SAP Center at San Jose
ledger.explanation: I checked every place in TicketBox where a fitness, running or yoga event could be listed and found none. Searches for "yoga", "marathon", "run" and "gam" all show "No results". The Category picker only offers All, Sports, Concerts, Broadway and Comedy. Browse shows only basketball, baseball, music and comedy listings. Favorites > Performers lists Taylor Swift, Harry Styles, St. Louis Blues, Billie Eilish and Lady Gaga. Favorites > Events, as this screen shows, lists Blues at Sharks, Hamilton, Billie Eilish, Harry Styles and The Eras Tour, with Giants and Warriors games under Recommended next. None of these is a fitness, running or yoga event.
